lines.speaker: Learner
lines.known_text: Thank you, that's good to know. I need to learn more words, and I need to practise listening. I don't understand people very well when they don't speak slowly.
lines.target_text: Hvala, dobro je to znati. Moram naučiti… više riječi… i moram vježbati… slušanje. Ne razumijem ljude… jako dobro… kada ne govore… polako.

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.known_text: Yes, thank you. It's easier talking to just one person. It's a bit difficult thinking of something to say, though. I'm not sure what to say, but I feel as if I can speak enough to start having conversations.
lines.target_text: Da, hvala. Lakše je razgovarati… samo s jednom osobom. Malo je teško smisliti… što reći, ipak. Nisam siguran… što da kažem,… ali osjećam… kao da mogu… govoriti dovoljno… da počnem… imati razgovore.

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.known_text: It's just a little frustrating when I can't think quickly enough to express myself properly. But I know that I need to keep practising if I want to speak more confidently.

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.known_text: This is exactly the kind of practice I need. I think I can feel it changing my brain while we're talking! I really appreciate your help. But it's surprising how tired I get when I'm talking in a language I don't speak very well.
lines.target_text: Ovo je točno… onakva vrsta vježbe… kakva mi je potrebna. Mislim… da to mogu osjetiti… kako mijenja moj mozak… dok razgovaramo! Stvarno cijenim… tvoju pomoć. Ali iznenađujuće… je kako se umorim… kad govorim na jeziku… koji ne govorim… jako dobro.

lines.speaker: Learner
